apply_chromatic_translation_augmentation: apply random color translation augmentation to sparse tensor features using ChromaticTranslation
apply_chromatic_auto_contrast_augmentati: apply auto contrast augmentation to sparse tensor RGB features using ChromaticAutoContrast
apply_hue_saturation_translation: apply hue and saturation translation augmentation to RGB features using HueSaturationTranslation
apply_elastic_distortion_augmentation: apply elastic distortion to sparse coordinates using ElasticDistortion with configurable granularity and magnitude
compose_multiple_transforms: compose multiple data transforms into a single pipeline using the Compose class
